newsitem.title: USA: Pacific cyclone becoming very dangerous - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Pacific cyclone becoming very dangerous - WSC.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Gavin continues to strengthen and is rapidly becoming very dangerous in the southwest Pacific, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.
Top winds are now 115 mph with the system located near the southern end of Tuvalu. Top winds may reach 140 mph in 24 hours as the storm turns towards the south.

It is expected to have winds of 115 mph when it reaches eastern Fiji in about 48 hours. Very strong winds and rough seas will be a major risk to shipping during the next 24-36 hours and the Fijian islands will be at risk of wind and flood damage in about 48 hours.
